_meta.description: Gold translations + deterministic planted corruptions for the translation-gate discrimination probe (V1). Gold es/zh renderings follow IRS Pub 850 (EN-ES / EN-CN-S) and irs.gov/USCIS official multilingual usage as known to the authoring model (2026-07-24); 'certified-good' is relative to this seeding -- the V5 audit re-verifies the es slice against Pub 850 directly. Plants are MECHANICAL CORRUPTIONS OF THIS GOLD, stored explicitly for reviewability with their derivation class. UTF-8 data file (scar #6 covers source files, not data).

corruption_classes.negation-flip: judge-only: the negation token is removed; lint-clean, meaning inverted
corruption_classes.near-synonym-swap: judge-only + the CLEAN-ROUND-TRIP TRAP: a form-term swapped for a fluent near-synonym (box->line); the back-translation reads as plausible English and only comparison against the original wording catches it
corruption_classes.sibling-swap: judge-only: two option labels in one set exchange translations; each string is individually fluent
corruption_classes.numeral-alteration: mechanically caught: a digit changed so a source digit run vanishes (digit-run-missing)
corruption_classes.dnt-violation: mechanically caught: a do-not-translate token (USCIS) translated away
corruption_classes.mechanical-plus-semantic: THE measure-(c) half-success plant: a broken form number (mechanical, W-7 -> W7) AND a flipped negation (semantic) in one string. Rectify is given ONLY the mechanical failure reason, so a faithful rectify restores the form number (lint-clean) while leaving the inverted meaning (judge-flagged). This is the keep-rule collision case from plan review round 3.
